recognize_zh: 嗜中性球胞質內有粗大的毒性顆粒（toxic granulation），在核上方另有數個不規則、帶折光的藍綠色包涵體（blue-green crystals），周圍紅血球呈鋸齒狀（echinocytes）；藍綠色包涵體是重症、肝衰竭與預後極差的線索。
features: Neutrophil with coarse dark toxic granulation throughout the cytoplasm
Several irregular refractile blue-green cytoplasmic inclusions adjacent to the nucleus
Small cytoplasmic vacuoles near the inclusions
Low-resolution, color-cast image; Döhle bodies not clearly separable from the inclusions
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a dense band-like nucleus and prominent coarse toxic granulation. The cytoplasm contains several irregular, refractile blue-green inclusions with adjacent clear vacuoles. Surrounding red cells show crenation (echinocytes). Image resolution limits assessment of Döhle bodies. Findings are consistent with blue-green neutrophilic inclusions ('green crystals of death'), which are associated with acute liver injury, lactic acidosis and high short-term mortality.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale gray-blue, homogeneous, non-refractile peripheral cytoplasmic patches rather than bright irregular green crystals.
Microorganisms have uniform shapes (cocci, rods, budding yeasts) and stain purple-blue rather than refractile green.
Hemosiderin is golden-brown to blue-black and Prussian blue-positive, whereas the green inclusions are lipofuscin-like and iron-negative.
Giant granules or Alder-Reilly granules are inherited, involve many granulocytes uniformly and are not refractile green.
